race.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
race.verdict: Unlike most of these, TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND brings an unexposed profile to the table so he's selected to make a successful reappearance. De Deli Counter is fit and in form so will doubtless be popular, with Wind Your Neck In also of some interest with a reappearance under his belt. TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND (IRE) DE DELI COUNTER WIND YOUR NECK IN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: De Deli Counter (5/2), Takeyoutotheisland (10/3), Pure Sirloin (9/2), Fearless Dragon (13/2), Wind Your Neck In (10/1), Kalo Athena (10/1), Monsieur Le Fuzz (14/1), Prince Nino (14/1), Solway Primrose (20/1), Lewa House (20/1), Jedhi Knight (25/1)
